items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But it was up there, right by Alderman Park, Henry Clay, I think, when I called you.

ctx.x: See, because I met them at Luzon and Ferret at 6.30. Mm-hmm. And Anderson wasn't long picking us up. And we hit right on out there to where they were farming at. See, what street was that? Who was it player for? Carson Noble, way out there in the Irish Channel. Who was it player for? Lions.
But it was up there, right by Alderman Park, Henry Clay, I think, when I called you.
Oh, that's where they left from, way up there. Yeah. Well, they didn't leave from the Lions Club. Mm-mm. The Lions is the Lion and Nance Asian.
